meta.title_plain: How a kid who drew his friends powered up a generation of manga artists
meta.teaser: Akira Toriyama came last, kept drawing, and created Dragon Ball.

page.title: How a kid who drew his friends powered up a generation of manga artists
page.bigIdea: Akira Toriyama's first stories flopped, but he kept drawing anyway. That stubborn practice led to Dragon Ball and inspired the creators of One Piece and Naruto.

cards.title: The kid who drew friends
cards.front: Akira was born in 1955 in Kiyosu, Japan.
cards.back: He loved drawing animals and cars. Everyone in his class copied manga. He got ahead of them when he started drawing his friends instead.
cards.tryit: Draw a friend or teammate as a cartoon character in 10 minutes.

cards.title: Last place, then 500 pages
cards.front: His first published story was in 1978.
cards.back: It was called Wonder Island, and it came last in the readers' vote. He was too stubborn to quit. He drew about 500 more pages in a year.
cards.tryit: Pick a skill you're bad at. Do 10 minutes of it today, just for practice.

cards.title: A super-strong robot girl
cards.front: In 1980, he finally had a hit.
cards.back: Dr. Slump starred Arale, a tiny robot girl who was super strong. It won a big award in 1981 and sold over 35 million copies in Japan.
cards.tryit: Invent a character who looks weak but has a surprise power. Sketch them.

cards.title: Kung fu films become Dragon Ball
cards.front: Dragon Ball sold about 260 million copies worldwide.
cards.back: He loved Jackie Chan movies, so in 1984 he started Dragon Ball. Fun fact: Super Saiyans got blond hair partly so there was less to ink.
cards.tryit: Watch a fight scene you like. Count how many moves happen in 10 seconds.

cards.title: Passing the power on
cards.front: Your favourite manga creators were his fans.
cards.back: Eiichiro Oda (One Piece) and Masashi Kishimoto (Naruto) were inspired by his work. In 2006, Toriyama and Oda even drew a crossover story together.
cards.tryit: Find one thing in One Piece that reminds you of Dragon Ball. Write it down.

quiz.q: What happened to Toriyama's first published story?
opts: It came last in a readers' vote
It became a movie right away
quiz.hint: Think about why he needed to be stubborn.
quiz.why: Wonder Island came last, but he kept drawing for a whole year.

quiz.q: Who was Arale in Dr. Slump?
quiz.hint: She looked small, but she wasn't weak.
quiz.why: Arale was a small robot with huge strength, and readers loved her.

quiz.q: Why did Super Saiyans get blond hair?
opts: So there was less to ink
quiz.hint: Think about the work of drawing every page by hand.
quiz.why: Blond hair meant less black ink to fill in, a smart shortcut for a busy artist.

quiz.q: Which creator was inspired by Toriyama?
quiz.hint: Look at idea 5 and think about pirates.
quiz.why: Oda grew up loving Toriyama's work and later drew a crossover with him.

page.think: Toriyama drew about 500 pages of stories that flopped before his big hit. What's something in tennis or school you'd keep working on, even after a "last place"?
